messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT — elevated 5xxs observed from /v1/generate (region: eu-central) starting ~20:12 UTC. Autoscaler not kicking in. Pager: Samira

Samira: on it. pulling runtime and gateway logs, checking model host health

Kenji: ping — do you want me to take IC? I can jump in if you need to lead mitigation

Samira: I can lead until containment. root symptom: sudden KV-cache eviction spikes causing frequent cold starts on model hosts -> 503s. posting live artifacts to the incident folder: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-5022

Tara: runtime node queues are piling (queue depth +300), p95 token latency up to 1.2s. eviction logs show repeated evict->repopulate cycles starting 20:11

Samira: mitigation plan: 1) reduce concurrency limit on model pool, 2) split 25% traffic to smaller-capacity fallback model, 3) temporarily increase KV cache memory allocation. Applying changes now.

Kenji: please paste commands for audit + runbook followup

Samira:
```
# 1) traffic split
redwoodctl routing patch --route /v1/generate --add-weight fallback-llm-small=25
# 2) reduce concurrency for pool
redwoodctl pool update --name model-pool-euc --max-concurrency 80
# 3) bump cache RAM
ansible-playbook ops/kv_scale.yml -e region=eu-central -e increase=15%
```

Tara: cache bump executed. monitoring eviction rate now.

CS-Bot: Notifying CX leads for impacted customers in eu-central (top 8 accounts)

Priya: creating alert ticket ALERT-1299 to add an autoscaler predicate on sustained kv_miss_rate > 5% for 2m

IncidentBot: MITIGATION APPLIED at 20:16 UTC — traffic split + cache bump + concurrency limit

Tara: after mitigation p95 dropped to ~320ms, 5xx rate back near baseline by 20:19

Samira: passing IC to Kenji for post-incident coordination — I need to log off but will respond to questions in thread

Kenji: taking over for postmortem. thanks for fast mitigation. initial RCA: a regression in eviction scoring in runtime v2.3.4 caused over-eager drop of hot prefixes under a certain request pattern (batch surge). autoscaler config lacks a KV-miss-based trigger, so it couldn’t react in time.

Luca: saved reproduction traces and perf harness to s3: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-5022/harness/ — logs + flamegraphs attached

Kenji: immediate action items (short list):
- A1: revert or patch eviction heuristic in runtime (owner: Tara)
- A2: add autoscaler predicate on kv_miss_rate and a synthetic test (owner: Priya)
- A3: update on-call runbook with explicit traffic-split + cache bump steps (owner: Samira)
- A4: prepare customer impact summary and coordinate with CS (owner: Luca)
- A5: add regression harness test to CI for this input pattern (owner: Kenji)

Samira: creating a runbook change now under docs/runtime/kv-cache — will submit PR and link here

OpsDocBot: DOC-TICKET created DOC-9021 for runbook edit; due 2026-03-22; assignee: Samira. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/DOC-9021

Kenji: scheduling postmortem meeting — propose 2026-03-19 15:00 UTC. Please RSVP. I'll include SRE, Runtime, Platform, CS, and Product Ops.

Luca: that time works for the teams I mentioned. I'll send calendar invite and include the draft customer note.

Priya: opened ALERT-1299 (autoscaler) and assigned to Platform team. ticket: https://redwood.internal/alerts/ALERT-1299

Tara: reproduction notes: harness reproduces eviction thrash with synthetic traffic that toggles hot-key distribution; artifacts uploaded to s3 path above. Initial hotfix branch created: runtime/eviction-fix-5022

Kenji: formal postmortem owner assigned to me. I'll publish a skeleton in the incident doc and attach owners + deadlines. Please add any missing evidence to the artifacts folder.

Samira: one runbook suggestion: add explicit handoff checklist lines for IC -> Postmortem coordinator (owner, meeting time, artifacts link, customer-notes status) so on-call doesn't have to improvise

OpsDocBot: DOC-TICKET DOC-9022 created: 'postmortem/customer-email-template' and linked to DOC-9021 & INC-5022

Kenji: thank you all. I'll close the PagerDuty incident after final verification. Postmortem draft target: EOD 2026-03-20. If anyone else finds new artifacts, please paste them into this thread.
